compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Moses descends with the tablets unaware that his face shines; Aaron and Israel fear, then approach; Moses gives the commands and uses a veil between speaking encounters.
observations.label: Moses descends shining and veils his face

observations.body: Moses descends shining and veils his face belongs to covenant renewed in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 34:29–35 supplies aftermath evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Renewal answers the breach without erasing the broken tablets, the judgment, or the need for pardon.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 34:29–35 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Moses descends shining and veils his face belongs to the covenant renewed movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
